mapper.select:
select g.*,s.supplier_name from goods as g left join supplier as s on g.supplier_id = s.supplier_id where 1=1
and g.goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{parm.goodsName},'%')
and s.supplier_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{parm.supplierName},'%')
and g.goods_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{parm.goodsCode},'%')
order by g.order_num desc
mapper.update: update goods set stock = stock + #{parm.goodsCount} where goods_id =#{parm.goodsId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(goods_id) AS less_count FROM goods WHERE stock < stock_warn
